# Register-ZbxPassiveAgentHandler

## SYNOPSIS

Registers a scriptblock that answers an item key on a running passive agent session.

## SYNTAX

### Direct (Default)

```
Register-ZbxPassiveAgentHandler [-Name] <string> [-Key] <string> [-ScriptBlock] <ScriptBlock> [-PassThru] [<CommonParameters>]
```

### Binding

```
Register-ZbxPassiveAgentHandler [-Name] <string> [-Binding] <ZabbixAgentHandlerBinding> [-PassThru] [<CommonParameters>]
```

## DESCRIPTION

The Register-ZbxPassiveAgentHandler cmdlet adds a handler to the passive agent session named in -Name: a scriptblock that answers -Key, run on the session's own runspace with the parsed key as its argument; its last output, as text, is the value the agent answers when the server or Get-ZbxAgentItem asks for that key. A binding from New-ZbxAgentHandler can be piped in instead. It refuses an active session; Register-ZbxAgentHandler takes either kind. It writes the session only with -PassThru.

## EXAMPLES

### Example 1: Answer a custom item key

```powershell
Register-ZbxPassiveAgentHandler -Name 'web-agent' -Key 'app.health' -ScriptBlock { 'ok' }
Get-ZbxAgentItem -Agent '127.0.0.1:30150' -Key 'app.health' | Select-Object Key, Value, IsSupported
```

The scriptblock runs on the session's own runspace (not this one: module commands and your variables are not there); its last output, converted to text, is the answer. The registration applies to the very next check.

### Example 2: Read the key's parameters

```powershell
Register-ZbxPassiveAgentHandler -Name 'web-agent' -Key 'app.queue' -ScriptBlock {
    param($key)
    @{ orders = 12; mail = 0 }[$key.Parameters[0]]
}
Get-ZbxAgentItem -Agent '127.0.0.1:30150' -Key 'app.queue[orders]', 'app.queue[mail]' | Select-Object Key, Value
```

The scriptblock's first argument is the parsed key: app.queue[orders] arrives with Parameters = orders.

### Example 3: Register a catalogue of handlers through the pipeline

```powershell
$handlers = @(
    New-ZbxAgentHandler -Key 'app.version' -ScriptBlock { '2.4.1' }
    New-ZbxAgentHandler -Key 'app.uptime' -ScriptBlock { 3600 }
)
$handlers | Register-ZbxPassiveAgentHandler -Name 'web-agent'
Get-ZbxAgentItem -Agent '127.0.0.1:30150' -Key 'app.version', 'app.uptime' | Select-Object Key, Value
```

New-ZbxAgentHandler builds key/scriptblock bindings once; piped in, each one binds to -Binding.

- `string`: Bound to -Name (ByPropertyName). Text.
- `ZabbixAgentHandlerBinding`: Bound to -Binding (ByValue). One key/scriptblock binding built by New-ZbxAgentHandler, for piping into the Register-Zbx*AgentHandler commands.

## OUTPUTS
